title: Name what kind of change a roster made
heading: Tell a Data Change and a Tie From a Regression
cases: an unchanged record is "same", and a record from other input data is "input"
the model minimizes cost, so a lower cost is "better" and a higher one "worse"
a cost within the tolerance with different assignments is a "tie", not a better or worse roster
when the input and the status both changed, the input explains the rest, so the answer is "input"
